html: Hi, is there a git repository to try to use your code and implement a linux version?

author: Gerrit Grunwald
html: Hi there, I did not publish the code of JDKMonitor because it is written in Swift, not Java. But I wrote a similar tool in Java which is already available for Mac, Linux and Windows, you can find it here JDKMon. It is similar but comes with different features.
